title: Stdlib spec runner cleanup supports current Behave registry
description:
Feature: Stdlib spec cleanup

Scenario: Runner cleanup works with current Behave StepRegistry
Given a stdlib BDD spec run completes
When TactusTestRunner cleanup runs
Then cleanup does not require StepRegistry.clear to exist
And the focused stdlib spec test can report the actual scenario result.

comments.author: derek.norrbom
comments.text: Fixed validation blocker found while running the new stdlib BDD spec in the Poetry Python 3.11 environment: TactusTestRunner.cleanup now clears Behave registries that expose steps but no clear() method. Added focused cleanup coverage.
